notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.2
notes.content:
Our second update brings fixes for some major crashes, and some small changes. Changes are the following:

- Performance improvments
- Chests now appear with a 100% chance until opened (cooldown 30 minutes)
- You can now press F3 to toggle debug information
- Resources can't be removed anymore when loading the map if they have a 100% spawn chance
- Fixed an issue in tutorial which was blocking tool selection
- Fixed an issue in tutorial that skipped steps when leaving the game and coming back
- Fixed Wrath generic story character near Roccenbeem
- Fixed cursor issue
- Fixed exploit about map depletion
- Fixed crash caused by some items when used
- Fixed XP granted by XP boost

You can continue sending us bug reports if you have additional crashes / bugs; do not forget, if you can, to press F3 if you have to send us screenshots along with your bug report. 

Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.1
notes.content:
The first update brings some fixes as well as some features that have been suggested. Changes are the following:

- Added lockpick and key as craftable items when starting a new game
- Number of Achivaras reduced for generic fighters (3 to 5 => 3 to 4)
- Added a "Music" sound slider in addition to the general volume slider
- Added a small light around Mercy at night (0.45 < radius < 0.55)
- Numbers (1 - 6) can now be used as a shortcut to select an action during fights
- Fixed Caeder house crash when building or skipping tutorial
- Fixed shop for lower screen resolutions
- Fixed tutorial being skipped when skipping intro
- Fixed sounds being played when not able to switch tools yet
- Fixed player being stuck inside a harvestable resource
- Fixed crash linked to shop
- Fixed Bledsong town issues

As always, feel free to contact us for any additional bug or feedback you may have so we can continue to improve Unleashed.
